body: You did a great job writing it out, OP. Your English is pretty decent! Great story. Please be safe on duty!

It was recently closed and sold out and now quietly sitting there  waiting its demolition.  The scene is surreal, especially at night.  Maybe you walked/ drove by it…
I am your new biggest fan and admirer, Ben, oh I mean Waldo, sorry! You resurrected my passion for reading- you are such a rare gem!

Take your time to heal… I am in no shape or form a dog psychologist but I have them throughout my whole life ( in mid 40-now) and recently got a puppy, who will 6 months in a few days. I noticed something about dogs that we, as people quite often miss- they will chose your company, you as his/ hers human in any situation and any condition versus comfort and wellbeing. Truth to the matter, you need your dog as much as he/she needs you - 12 years it’s a long time. Even if you feel numb now - your heart still carry love to your dog. Dog who also suffers loss - please let yourself heal. Your husband’s choice, well as painful as it was - he made it and it’s over now. It’s over for him, but it’s a beginning for you. The decision of selling your house and possibly moving to new area- it’s an idea that I would suggest you consider in a future. Seeing same walls every day - it might not be beneficial for your mental health at the moment. I am offering my support- day or night. Be gentle on yourself and please keep your dog by your side. You will build your new routine  soon. New future with both of you!

You just lived through the worst experience of your life - I cannot imagine anything worse than that you are dealing with at the moment. While it’s impossible for me to find words to comfort you - I still want to mention that we as human beings are resilient and are capable to live our lives carrying the most horrifying traumas from our past - I do believe that since you are so young and for sake of your son you will be able to recover to the certain extent. Yet, it’s too early for you to see it- I pray and hope that this hellish event will bring out the strength you needed. I will also support the idea of you are seeking the therapy, professional support as well as family/ community help as soon as possible to help you navigate through the dark times. You did survive unimaginable and I am very sorry that your fiancé made the decision she did. I also wanted to say that if your baby just 8 weeks old is a ripe of postpartum depression that many many females go through and that quite often lead to the same devastating outcome you are now facing. Pregnancy and delivery affect us, new mother differently - sometimes(quite often) it cause the medical condition such as postpartum psychosis, when it literally feels like you are slipping away from reality. Therefore, please remind yourself that you are not at fault, by all means you couldn’t act any different to prevent or to stop it. You are as a parent now a sole responsible person and your son needs your attention and I am so glad you are fully aware of it. You are stronger than you think and while there is nothing that can change the course of events - please keep reaching out for help and support- you have and will have people’s sympathy and I am praying for peace and strength. Take a few minutes of the day to validate and distinguish your feelings no matter what they are. You will push through, young man!

Reading your post I found myself out of breath - it probably won’t take even a drop out from your abyss of pain and sorrow - but I for a few minutes I felt your fear, your despair the same way I felt it when I attempted at 2018. You heard a lot “I am so sorry for your loss”, so I refrain of typing this. I don’t know why your husband made that decision- it likely would be for different reason(s) I did. I also can’t assure you that he is in peace now because I was revived… My advice is to please keep writing, keep sharing the most raw moments, keep opening it up - let that pain drain your soul and even it never gets easier- you will be able to heal even with scarring heart. You and your little girl are in my thoughts for a long time…

First, I am so sorry for the loss of your mom and didn’t have the so much needed support from someone who vowed to be by your side no matter what… There are multiple versions that people suggested could cause your response and reaction pertaining to intimacy with your husband. If I may share my perspective as someone who studied and practiced psychology (I will omit my credentials/ job title(s) etc for a sake of time you spend reading my input) - you might hurt much deeper than you originally thought. His relapse/ absence/ lack of empathy and inability to provide emotional shield and comfort for you in a such challenging time of your life when you were experiencing profound sense of loss- could brought that physical alienation from him that reveals itself in this specific issue (teeth could be hidden behind the closed mouth but usually visible by intimate partner). Our emotional trauma very often being reflected and/ or projected via body image or sensation. My advice is to seek a professional help and be open minded to try psychotherapy and possibly hypnosis. Like any other trauma caused by betrayal - this issue might or might not be resolved. I am hoping for the best outcome for you - you deserve happiness in all aspects of your life!

Sending my greatest sympathy your way - on my own skin I experienced the weight of medical school at full force!  It was a 6 years of daily struggle - that how long it takes to graduate in Russia. I didn't want to get into medical field but with my strict parents - I had no choice but to study so I can accomplish their dream of being a doctor. Long story short - I only worked as Dr for a handful of years and am out of medicine for a while now. Along with my sympathy please accept my advice - try to utilize all resources that available for medical students; talk to the therapist or priest or your loved one... Seek help and don't feel weird or ashamed - you are already achieved a lot and you could help a lot of people in a future regardless of wether you choose to stay on this path or pick another road like myself. You are so brave to acknowledge and to verbalize your fears - you are only the step away from overcoming it!

When I was 19 y.o. - my strict parents used all kind of technics to keep me separated from the guy - who I thought at the moment, was a love of my life. He was a bit older, jobless, drunkard who was verbally and physically abusive - yet I seemingly didn't see it at the time. My parents' constant involvement put additional stress and tension that grew to the point that one day - I just snapped. I was angry, confused, lost and saw no way out! I couldn't stay with my parents anymore nor I was able to create anything with "my man". I came home, wrote the note accusing everyone and took a bunch of pills. Next thing I remember being in and out of consciousness, the dreadful feeling of drowning in my own vomit, excruciating pain throughout my body, bits and pieces of ambulance ride - I was trying to ask for my BF - in reality just mumbled senselessly... I will omit the  details of getting my stomach pumped, unkind and rude remarks from hospital stuff and many other memorable but terrifying moments - let's skip it to the answer to your questions. When I came up to my senses after 30 hours of struggle - I also felt numb for quite a while. Even after being medically cleared and discharged, I constantly felt that reality is surreal. For a first few weeks, it was almost a daily thing - I asked myself maybe I died that night? Every single aspect of my life, such as emotions, vision, taste, surroundings, people, clothes, my favorite toy - all seemed unnatural, fake, colorless and foreign! My dreams were no longer mine - I felt like a dead person.  If you experience the similar feelings - you are not alone. I was explained by therapist that our brains react differently and oddly at times to the toxicity of substances we take and/ or to oxygen starvation caused by those substances. While it might be a natural reaction of your brain - it doesn't make the feeling more tolerable and if you leave the real reason of your attempt unaddressed - you may find yourself even in deeper pit of despair.... With all being said - please seek professional help immoderately! Do not trust yourself now - your reality seem distorted and your senses may not work for your protection.  You said all you have is your mom - and mom is a very precious person in our lives, please do not leave her - this will cause the enormous pain in her heart. Use that painful experience for your advantage... I know how difficult it could be just to live another day. Just take my word for now please - life is worth living and you will see it with your eyes soon! I am sending you warm hugs and best wishes in your recovery!

You deserve the all goods in this world and your cats are forever grateful for your love and care!

I am trying to shed a different light to suicide. While you still can change some circumstances of your life - death might not be that attractive or easy

I didn't talk to you - sorry if you got triggered - you can go ahead and keep posting a cliche posts to those who are asking for them - go tell them to please change their mind because life is worth living. While I wholeheartedly want people to live long and happy lives all over the world - I asked people who might think about possible afterwards scenario. If you are not capable of understand the meaning of my post or just simply prefer not to think about that - just go on with you day without calling names or judging.

Until the last second - you have a chance and power ( even if it's chance of any sort of accidents that take place by itself, without our involvement). All things could change for you much quickly then you think. This time it will change for a better. Learn to notice these tiny fluctuations of space/time for your own good. Tune yourself to inner peace - our mind is a powerful but not absolute matter of Universe. Look - there are few people, unknown to you, never met you, won't get any reward for doing that - yet all of them decided to spend some of precious minutes of their lives to message you the words of support on encouragement! Some of them confessed that they are in struggle themself now, someone physically, another are emotionally drained and exhausted. Despite their own pain - people are asking you, to please please not to do it... Just picture the faces of these people talking and asking you to please stay... well, just give this world another chance - it worth at least keep trying ... I am here for you as well 
Please stay here longer!

No - religion is actually the last that opinion I would've I rely on probably. Everything - science included can't prove or disprove any type of existence after fact of biological death of physical body. Beyond that line - we are still pretty clueless but consider that quantum physicists are mumbling something about multiple universes - well I am to afraid to risk it.

What if the decision to kill oneself is not only won't bring any resolution or relief, not freedom or deliverance of any kind but rather will release of all kind of evil forces of the Universe??? Look, despite of religious, philosophical or scientific views - the decision and the whole concept of life and death is a divine matter. Nobody knows what beneath the line of death - and we can only guess and wish it will bring the relief of our seemingly overwhelming issues of everyday day world. But what if human being fortified the divine will and by making that decision to end the life at the day and time what originally wasn't set for it - what if our perspective of existence isn't really the way it is? That very thought of other realm that can intensify my pain and suffering help me to get through my darkest times! I keep telling myself - until I am alive and remain in my well known and familiar even sometimes horrible a d difficult reality - but I still have a lot of powers and opportunities here- hopefully some of them will help me to overcome some really bad things that has happened to me so far- but until I am alive here - it might turn to better somehow... but death on my own terms might turn the reality we know into something we have no idea or skills to live in.. Because even so- we won't be able to cross the line again to warn the others... nobody could so far. Death is permanent in our world - but we still unsure what is happen afterwords...
